'''Saberjowls''' were large aquatic creatures that lived in the oceans of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> They were one of several [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Eel/Legends|eel]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Characteristics==
An adult member of this [[Species/Legends|species]] were measured at 100 meters in length with mouths large enough to consume an entire [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] with a single bite. They possessed small claws, which were believed to be vestigial fangs, that allowed them to manipulate the prey and force it into the saberjowl's mouth. They were known to possess scales that were green in color allowing them to blend in with the waters of Kamino. They also possessed a short row of fins along the dorsal ridge which added to their balance when swimming.

==History==
It was learned that the saberjowls were actually a genetically engineered creature made from the material that made [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> to which the saberjowl appeared almost identical. The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] cloners admitted in several documents that the introduction of the saberjowl to the waters of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was an accident. Furthermore, later attempts to breed the creatures led to a limitation of their reproductive capabilities.

One such creature attacked [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when his starfighter crashed during the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]].
